117.protocol: Custom 316L SLM data: 15 process settings, 45 cubes/255 captured layers; three quality classes based on porosity and relative density. Overlapping track-step signal windows converted to 64×64 images; per-class random 80/20 train/test split (60,424/15,107 images), plus random ten-fold CV. Accuracy and per-image classification time; acoustic-only and photodiode-only variants and eight alternative architectures (§4, PDF pp9–12).

Direct negative examples in Table3: LeNet-5 fusion 90.71% < photodiode 91.04%; RNN fusion 88.24% < photodiode 92.43%; LSTM fusion 90.35% < acoustic 92.13%. Modal data are explicitly not registered (§3.2). Labels summarize part-quality categories, not localized pore ground truth. No confidence intervals or seed-repeat uncertainty established.
